exercises.question: Which sentence shows the ONLY type of *leísmo* that the RAE educated norm accepts (referring to a singular male person as a direct object)?
options: A nuestro vecino don Marcos le vimos ayer en la biblioteca central.
A nuestra vecina doña Elena le vimos ayer en la biblioteca central.
El informe anual ya le leímos ayer en la biblioteca central.
A nuestros vecinos del primer piso les vimos ayer en la biblioteca central.

exercises.question: A speaker from Madrid says: *«A mi hermana la dije toda la verdad ayer por la tarde»*. How does the standard norm classify this usage, and what is the standard form?
options: It is a case of *laísmo* (rejected by the norm); the standard form is «A mi hermana le dije toda la verdad».
It is an accepted case of *leísmo* of person; the standard form is «A mi hermana la dije toda la verdad».
It is a case of *loísmo* (rejected by the norm); the standard form is «A mi hermana lo dije toda la verdad».
It is the general Latin American standard; the indirect object takes «la» whenever the recipient is female.
